reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Serum 50ml
reviews.text: it's my third time getting this serum, the acne line from this brand it's just so good. it's definitely oily so wear it at night and wash it off in the morning. my skin feels very moisturized afterwards and it does calm the irritation over time.
reviews.zh: 第三次入手呢枝精華，呢個品牌嘅暗瘡系列真係好正。質地明顯偏油，所以夜晚搽，聽朝洗面時洗走就得。用完之後皮膚感覺好保濕，慢慢亦都舒緩到泛紅同刺激。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Serum 50ml
reviews.text:
The texture is very light, almost like water. I use it every other day, and I can already see a change in my skin’s texture. It has helped fade my acne spots that I haven’t been able to treat for over two years.
I’ve been using the product for two months and I’m already seeing results.
reviews.zh: 質地非常輕，幾乎好似水一樣。我隔日用一次，已經見到膚質有變化。幫到手淡咗困擾我兩年多嘅暗瘡印。我用咗兩個月，已經見到效果。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Serum 50ml
reviews.text: LOVE! It is one of the very few serums that I can use daily for gently exfoliation without irritating my skin and it works great! When I have stubborn closed comedones or an annoying pimple, I put this at night and the next morning it is calmer or even gone, it works great on my skin.
reviews.zh: 真心鍾意！係少數我可以用得每日、溫和去角質又唔會刺激皮膚嘅精華，效果好好！當我遇到頑固嘅閉口粉刺或者煩人嘅暗瘡，夜晚搽完，聽朝已經退咗紅甚至消失晒，喺我塊面真係好 work。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Serum 50ml
reviews.text:
I have been using this for 4 months consistently and I can say that it's the best, non irritating serum I've ever used! Works great on mixed/black skin (both my husband and I have used this to get rid of hyperpigmentation and heal acne fast).

 It doesn't sting, no strong scent (just a light tea tree smell), can be used without layering moisturizer on top and a little goes a long way. I've even started using it on my chestne and kp bumps on my arms and it works there to (a bit more slowly, but it works!). 

The light exfoliating of the BHA PHA is phenomenal and gives the skin a nice clear glow and I have found myself exfoliating less (I haven't had a chemical exfoliation and chemical peel in over a year) I've found that as long as I drink enough water, eat clean and get enough sleep combined with this I have almost glass skin. I rarely use makeup (not even my fave tinted sunscreen) anymore. I hope they never change this formula!
reviews.zh: 我持續用咗四個月，可以講係我用過最好、最唔刺激嘅精華！對混合性／黑人膚色都好有效（我同老公都用嚟褪色素沉著同加快暗瘡復原）。唔會拮、冇乜香味（只有淡淡茶樹味），唔使再疊保濕霜都用到，仲要好少量已經夠用。我仲開始搽落胸口嘅暗瘡同手臂上嘅雞皮粒，都係 work 嘅（慢少少，但 work！）。BHA PHA 嘅溫和去角質效果超班，搞到皮膚有種透亮感，發覺自己都少咗額外去角質（我已經超過一年冇做過化學去角質同化學換膚）。我覺得只要飲夠水、食得清同瞓得夠，再配埋呢枝精華，我塊面幾乎係玻璃肌。我已經好少化妝（連我最鍾意嘅有色防曬都唔使再搽）。希望佢哋永遠唔好改呢個配方！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Serum 50ml
reviews.text: I’m not sure if it works yet. I’ve had more breakouts in the last few days, I’m wondering if this is my skin purging or if it’s really irritating my skin. Going to try it for a few more weeks…
reviews.zh: 我都唔確定係咪 work。近幾日爆多咗瘡，我唔知係皮膚排毒定真係刺激到。再試多幾星期先講…

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Serum 50ml
reviews.text: This is my 3rd time buying this product from SOME BY MI. It works really well for my skin by gently exfoliating and keeping my pores clear. I love how smooth and clean my skin feels after using it. I’m very satisfied and will keep repurchasing it.
reviews.zh: 第三次喺 SOME BY MI 買呢款產品。佢溫和去角質，搞到我毛孔清清哋，超啱我用。用完之後皮膚滑又乾淨，感覺好正。好滿意，會繼續回購。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Serum 50ml
reviews.text: Be honest. I was affraid this would be was of money, but It is absolutely not! the water pil composition is amazing. I applied it in the evening. The feeling was very ok on my skin that I did not need applied any cream afterward, but I rather did. I woke up in the morning and my skin looked like silk, realy! And it wasnt because of night cream, cos I used it everynight. The Some bi me changed the skin!
reviews.zh: 講真。本來都怕會嘥錢，但絕對唔係！水狀嘅配方好正。我夜晚搽。搽完感覺好舒服，所以本來可以唔再搽面霜，但我自己選擇咗再搽。聽朝起身塊面好似絲咁滑，真係！唔係因為晚霜嘅功勞，因為晚霜我每晚都用緊。Some By Mi 改變咗我塊面！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Serum 50ml
reviews.text: Some By Mi is quickly becoming one of my favorite brands, this serum is perfect for sensitive skin and has an amazing calming/cooling effect. I have noticed a decrease in facial acne since using this serum (paired with their cleanser and toner). 10/10 will buy again.
reviews.zh: Some By Mi 快速成為我最鍾意嘅品牌之一，呢枝精華對敏感肌嚟講係完美嘅選擇，有超好嘅舒緩／降紅效果。用咗呢枝精華之後（配佢哋嘅潔面同爽膚水），我面頰上嘅暗瘡明顯減少咗。10/10，一定會再買。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
